title: Derived strong monoidality from flat-preserving ordinary pullback
statement: Use [def-weil-pbc-residue-exchange-comparison-interface]. For an additive exact strong monoidal left adjoint F between the monoidal Grothendieck abelian categories with functorial flat resolutions, assume F preserves flat objects. Construct the strong monoidal structure on F.leftDerivedFunctor from its canonical tensor comparison. Specializing to the actual ordinary integral pullback, a supplied ordinary monoidal structure and proof of flat preservation give a constructed monoidal structure on residueExchangeUpperStar. No data is obtained from an unproved existence theorem. A local named copy of the existing integral derived monoidal instance is definitionally equal to it and marked instance_reducible so consumers retain typeclass compatibility.

source.place: Lemma 6.5.9(3), Proposition 6.8.11(3), Remark 6.8.15; explicit formal coefficient and adjunction argument

proof.text: A flat-preserving colimit-preserving functor sends the functorial flat resolution to a K-flat complex. The kFlatMap localizer has left resolutions; therefore every derived object is isomorphic to the quotient of an object in kFlatMap.

Apply OplaxMonoidal.ofLaxSquare to the canonical left-derived tensor comparison, its counit compatibility, and the kFlatMap resolutions. The derived tensor comparisons are invertible on these resolutions; the derived unit comparison is invertible as well.

CoreMonoidal.ofOplaxMonoidal turns this oplax structure with invertible tensor and unit maps into a strong monoidal structure. Specialize the actual typed pull functor by unfolding its wrapper only at this API boundary.
